title: Belgian authorities force Google to halt data center construction

blocks.text: BRUSSELS, Belgium — Belgian authorities have ordered Google to suspend construction of a data center in the south of the country because of a lack of proper planning permission, a regional official said Friday. “We have identified a major offense: the illegal construction of a building covering three hectares,” or 7.4 acres, Nicolas Yernaux, spokesman for the Wallonia regional authorities, told Agence France-Presse. The “stop-work” order at the former mining site covering some 50 hectares in total comes after NGO Greenpeace accused Google of carrying on construction despite lacking the correct permits.
